name: E2E：生图节点-打包输出模式端到端验证
description: 配置生图节点输出模式为'多张图打包在一起'，保存后试运行，验证输出结果为打包格式(单个URL/zip/压缩包引用)

steps.description: 打开含生图节点的策略详情页
验证生图详情页已加载

steps.expression: return (() => { const allEls = document.querySelectorAll('*'); for (const el of allEls) { const t = (el.textContent || '').trim(); if (t === '生图' && el.children.length === 0) { const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect(); if (rect.width > 0 && rect.height > 0) { el.click(); return { clicked: true }; } } } return { clicked: false }; })()

return (() => { const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer:not(.ant-drawer-hidden)'); if (!drawer) return { open: false }; const radios = Array.from(drawer.querySelectorAll('.ant-radio-wrapper')); const radioInfo = radios.map(r => ({ label: (r.textContent || '').trim(), checked: !!r.querySelector('input[type=radio]:checked') })); const checked = radioInfo.find(r => r.checked); return { open: true, radios: radioInfo, currentMode: checked ? checked.label : null, isPackMode: checked ? (checked.textContent || '').includes('打包') : false }; })()

return (() => { const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer:not(.ant-drawer-hidden)'); if (!drawer) return { skipped: true }; const radios = Array.from(drawer.querySelectorAll('.ant-radio-wrapper')); const packRadio = radios.find(r => { const t = (r.textContent || '').trim(); return t.includes('打包') || t.includes('多张图'); }); if (!packRadio) return { noPackRadio: true }; const inp = packRadio.querySelector('input[type=radio]'); if (inp) { inp.click(); return { switched: true, to: (packRadio.textContent || '').trim() }; } return { noRadioInput: true }; })()
steps.description: 切换输出模式为'多张图打包在一起'

steps.expression: return (() => { const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer:not(.ant-drawer-hidden)'); if (!drawer) return {}; const radios = Array.from(drawer.querySelectorAll('.ant-radio-wrapper')); const checked = radios.find(r => !!r.querySelector('input[type=radio]:checked')); const modelSelect = drawer.querySelector('.ant-select'); const modelValue = modelSelect ? (modelSelect.querySelector('.ant-select-selection-item')?.textContent || '').trim() : ''; return { confirmedMode: checked ? (checked.textContent || '').trim() : 'unknown', modelValue, isPack: checked ? (checked.textContent || '').includes('打包') : false }; })()
steps.description: 确认输出模式已设为打包模式
输出模式已切换为'多张图打包在一起'

steps.expression: return (() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal:not(.ant-modal-hidden)'); if (!modal) return { open: false }; const inputs = Array.from(modal.querySelectorAll('input:not([type=checkbox]), textarea')); const filledInputs = {}; for (const inp of inputs) { const label = (inp.closest('.ant-form-item')?.querySelector('.ant-form-item-label')?.textContent || '').trim(); if (label.includes('seller')) { const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set; setter.call(inp, 'test_seller_001'); inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); filledInputs.seller_id = 'test_seller_001'; } } return { open: true, filledInputs }; })()

return (() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal:not(.ant-modal-hidden)'); if (!modal) return { ok: false }; const btns = Array.from(modal.querySelectorAll('button')); const runBtn = btns.find(b => { const t = (b.textContent || '').trim(); return t === '运行' || t === '开始运行' || t.includes('运行'); }); if (runBtn && !runBtn.disabled) { runBtn.click(); return { ok: true, buttonText: (runBtn.textContent || '').trim() }; } return { ok: false, disabled: runBtn?.disabled }; })()

steps.description: 等待生图运行完成(可能耗时较长)

steps.expression: return (() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal:not(.ant-modal-hidden)'); if (modal) { const closeBtn = modal.querySelector('.ant-modal-close'); if (closeBtn) closeBtn.click(); } return { closed: true }; })()

steps.description: 等待弹窗关闭和状态更新

steps.expression: return (() => { const btns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')); const resultBtn = btns.find(b => { const t = (b.textContent || '').trim(); return t === '查看运行结果'; }); if (resultBtn) { resultBtn.click(); return { clicked: true, text: '查看运行结果' }; } const allBtns = btns.map(b => (b.textContent||'').trim()).filter(Boolean); return { clicked: false, buttonLabels: allBtns.slice(0, 15) }; })()
steps.description: 点击查看运行结果按钮
等待运行结果页面加载

steps.expression: return (() => { const text = document.body.innerText || ''; const urls = text.match(/https?:\/\/[^\s"']+(?:\.jpg|\.png|\.webp|\.jpeg)/gi) || []; const allHttpUrls = text.match(/https?:\/\/[^\s"'<]+/gi) || []; const zipUrls = allHttpUrls.filter(u => u.includes('.zip') || u.includes('.tar') || u.includes('.gz') || u.includes('download') || u.includes('package')); const hasResult = text.includes('运行结果') || text.includes('成功') || text.includes('完成') || text.includes('输出') || text.includes('试运行') || text.includes('策略'); const hasError = text.includes('失败') || text.includes('错误'); const hasLoading = text.includes('运行中') || !!document.querySelector('.ant-spin-spinning'); const hasViewBtn = text.includes('查看运行结果'); const hasPackKeyword = text.includes('打包') || text.includes('zip') || text.includes('package') || text.includes('压缩'); return { hasLoading, hasResult, hasError, hasViewBtn, imageUrlCount: urls.length, imageUrls: urls.slice(0, 10), allUrlCount: allHttpUrls.length, allUrls: allHttpUrls.slice(0, 15), zipUrlCount: zipUrls.length, zipUrls: zipUrls.slice(0, 5), hasPackKeyword }; })()

steps.label: e2e-pack-mode-result
steps.description: 打包模式试运行结果截图

_testDesign.preconditions: F88预发已登录；策略10602含生图节点且配置完整(模型类型/Prompt/输入图片)
_testDesign.realDomNotes: 打包模式: 多张图片打包为一个输出(可能是zip/压缩包/单个URL引用); 输出格式与单图模式不同
riskPoints: 打包模式输出是否为单个URL/引用(非多个独立URL)
打包文件是否可正常下载/解压
输出格式是否与单图模式有明显区分
运行是否超时(生图+打包耗时可能更长)
_testDesign.validationRule: 输出结果应体现打包特征(单一URL/zip引用/打包关键字)，与单图模式的多URL输出形成对比
